name: T-Mobile US, Inc.
description: T-Mobile US is a single-segment wireless carrier (it does not break out Consumer/Business the way Verizon and AT&T do) offering postpaid and prepaid mobile service nationwide, plus a fast-growing 5G Home Internet fixed-wireless broadband product. T-Mobile has expanded into wireline fiber broadband not by building or buying networks outright but through 50/50 joint ventures with private-equity partners (Lumos with EQT, closed April 2025; Metronet with KKR, closed July 2025), and closed its ~$4.4 billion acquisition of United States Cellular's wireless operations, transferring most of UScellular's subscribers, retail stores and about 30% of its spectrum holdings to T-Mobile.

businessLines.description: Recurring monthly service revenue from postpaid phone and other postpaid (tablet, wearable, home internet) subscribers; T-Mobile's primary profit driver.

brands.name: T-Mobile (postpaid/premium wireless)
brands.note: Primary consumer and business wireless brand

brands.name: Mint Mobile
brands.note: Digital-first low-cost MVNO-style prepaid brand, acquired by T-Mobile in 2023

brands.name: UScellular wireless operations
brands.note: T-Mobile's $4.4bn acquisition of most of UScellular's wireless customers, retail stores and ~30% of its spectrum holdings; regulatory approval received, deal integration ongoing

brands.name: Lumos (fiber JV with EQT)
brands.note: T-Mobile invested ~$950 million for a 50% equity interest in a joint venture with EQT that acquired fiber-to-the-home provider Lumos, closed April 2025; not wholly owned or consolidated

brands.name: Metronet (fiber JV with KKR)
brands.note: T-Mobile invested ~$4.9 billion for a 50% equity stake in a joint venture with KKR that acquired fiber-to-the-home provider Metronet, closed July 24 2025; not wholly owned or consolidated

whatsNext.text: T-Mobile targets reaching 12-15 million fiber households by end of 2030 through its Lumos and Metronet joint ventures
UScellular wireless-operations integration ongoing following 2025 regulatory approval
